issues.least_adequate_overall_repair:
Bypass (11) in Lemma 2 when proving Theorem 1: estimate $e_h - \mathcal{E}e_h$ directly from (10) using polynomial trace and inverse inequalities, bounding face jumps of $e_h$ by elementwise values of $|
abla_h e_h|$, which after element-to-element shift change is controlled by $\|F(
abla_h v_h) - F(
abla_h u_h)\|_{L^2}^2 + \|F(
abla_h v_h) - F(
abla u)\|_{L^2}^2$. For Theorem 4, restrict (11) in Lemma 2 to $u_h = 0$ (so $e_h = v_h = \mathcal{I}_{	ext{NC}} v$, ensuring the shift $|
abla_h v_h|$ matches the vector in the jump), correct the dual notation in Theorem 4 and Theorem 3 to $(\phi_{|
abla v|})^*$, and replace the typo $u$ with $v$ in Theorem 4.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of the second bound in Lemma 2 fails. Because Theorem 1 relies directly on Lemma 2 to absorb the non-conforming enrichment error terms, the medius analysis proof of Theorem 1 fails. Consequently, the quasi-optimality and a priori bounds in Theorems 1, 2, 3, and 4 are unsupported as written.
issues.title: Invalid shift equivalence in Case 2 of Lemma 2 and missing jump control in Theorem 1
issues.why_classification: The issue requires replacing the faulty jump equivalence in Lemma 2 and repairing the companion stability argument in Theorem 1 using local polynomial inverse inequalities and shift changes, but it does not require abandoning the main theorems or redesigning the overarching medius analysis framework.
